Du passt zu uns, wenn …
… du langjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Softwareentwicklung im JVM-Umfeld mitbringst und vertraut mit Enterprise-Standards (Spring) und modernen Ansätzen bist.
… du Cloud-Native Architekturen (idealerweise Azure) verstehst und tiefes DevOps-Verständnis mitbringst

Du triffst Architektur- und Tech-Entscheidungen selbst und trägst dein Feature vom Konzept bis zum Betrieb.

Festes Lernbudget, Zeit für Zertifikate und Konferenzbesuche. Dein Wachstum ist eingeplant, nicht optional.

Direkte Kommunikation bis zur Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen im Team, nicht in Gremien.
Unbefristete Festanstellung mit überdurchschnittlichem Gehalt und einem Unternehmen, das seit 2006 stabil wächst.

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more.

As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization.

Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 25 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. Position Summary Harness Software Engineering Insights (SEI) is where engineering meets engineering intelligence.

As part of this team, you’ll work on a deeply technical product that connects to 40+ developer tools like Jira and GitHub, processes millions of events, and turns raw SDLC data into actionable metrics. This is a product that engineers build for engineers, where you’ll see your work directly impact how thousands of developers build software.

Expect challenges in data modeling, systems design, developer UX, and secure cloud integrations — all to help engineers and leaders build faster, better, and smarter. About The Role Design, develop, deploy and maintain critical software in a fast-paced quality conscious Java environment.

Author software functional specifications and design documents for features developed.

Quickly understand complex systems/code and own key pieces of the system, including the delivered quality Work in an agile environment, using iterative development cycles and a short customer feedback loop Design and implementation of scalable backend software solutions Diagnose and troubleshoot complex problems in a distributed computing environment.

Perform peer reviews of specifications, design, and code Quickly understand complex systems/code and own key pieces of the system, including the delivered quality Work alongside Site Reliability Engineers/DevOps and cross functional teams to deploy software or diagnose/troubleshoot any production related issues About You 8-10+ years of experience developing highly scalable, distributed applications, products, and backend services using Java A desire to build products that solve complex technical problems for end users Experience with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL Experience with SQL query tuning, performance optimizations is a plus Experience with search frameworks like Elasticsearch, SOLR is a plus Experience with applications hosted on AWS/Azure/GCP is a plus Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD processes is a plus Deep understanding of how distributed resilient software is built and deployed Excellent problem solving and debugging skills Experience working in short release cycles Ready to Build Something Engineers Love.

This is your chance to shape the systems that shape how software gets built. Join Harness today!

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience.

The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale.

Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.
As a Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll build and improve the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly.

You'll work primarily in React and TypeScript to ship polished, reliable, high-performing borrower flows, while partnering with backend, product, and design to connect those experiences to the systems behind pricing, underwriting, and funding.

This is a hands-on role where you'll own meaningful features end to end and grow your technical depth on a business-critical product.

Build and maintain borrower-facing web experiences using React and TypeScript, translating designs and product requirements into clean, responsive, accessible interfaces.
Work across the stack to connect frontend experiences to backend services and APIs, contributing to full-stack features that span the borrower journey.
Partner closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to scope, build, and ship features that improve borrower flows and reduce friction.
Write well-tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, helping raise the quality and consistency of the team's frontend codebase.
Contribute to performance, reliability, and observability of the experiences you own, and help debug and resolve issues across environments.
Support experimentation and iterative improvements to borrower flows, using data and feedback to inform what gets built next.

Strong proficiency building web applications with React and TypeScript, including component design, state management, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.

Solid fundamentals in writing tested, maintainable code and collaborating through code review in a team environment.
Ability to work effectively with product and design partners to deliver features from requirements through production.

Experience building consumer-facing products with attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.

Exposure to fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys.

Active use of AI tools in engineering workflows, with a thoughtful perspective on how AI is reshaping software development.
Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Staff Software Engineer, Web to the Engineering team.

Sprout empowers over 30,000 global brands to harness the power of social media, operating on a true "tech-giant" scale. Every day, our engineering infrastructure processes tens of billions of requests and asynchronous events, ingests billions of social messages, and drives over 1,000 production deployments every month, all while embedding cutting-edge AI directly into our platform.
Sprout Engineering sits at the intersection of massive scale, technical craft, and tight-knit collaboration across mobile, front-end, back-end, and site reliability engineering.

Instead of being a small cog in a massive machine, you’ll solve complex distributed systems problems alongside exceptional peers in an environment built for high autonomy and fast execution.

Because our platform is a multi-product suite, you have the unique opportunity to explore new technologies, shift across domains, and continuously diversify your skills without ever needing to change companies—accelerating your career while making a direct impact on our customers every single day.

Write clean, performant, and maintainable code.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to other team members, including junior engineers.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend developers, designers, and product managers, to deliver world class customer experiences.
Participate in and conduct code reviews to maintain code quality, provide feedback, and ensure adherence to coding standards.
Continuously improve the codebase by identifying areas for refactoring and optimization to enhance maintainability and scalability.

We’re looking for a creative, highly motivated, and inquisitive learner to build great software with us. If you confidently write web applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, we’d love to talk with you!

s.h: The minimum qualifications for this role include
s.t:
7+ years of experience with planning, building, and releasing frontend applications with web technologies (React, JavaScript, TypeScript)
Experience building web applications with TypeScript

s.h: Preferred qualifications for this role include
s.t:
Experience working as a full stack engineer.
Experience working with Node.js
Experience working in a large codebase
Experience building and/or maintaining an internal UI library
Communication and project management skills from collaborating with people across different teams and functional areas.
How you’ll grow

s.h: Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including
s.t:
Complete Sprout’s New Hire training program alongside other new Sprout team members.
Deliver business value by shipping your first code change with active pairing/mentoring from your teammates.
Learn how code is deployed to our end users through collaboration with front end developers on your team.
Have a firm understanding of the team’s roadmap and the team’s Agile processes by having discussions with your team’s manager.

s.h: Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by
s.t:
Independently own and deliver the front end part of small to medium features without peer consultation
Adhere to the team’s engineering best practices, such as testing expectations, shared patterns, and documentation.
Openly communicate with all disciplines of the team, including back-end engineers, product design and product managers, in order to move the team’s work forward.
Contribute to team processes by participating in team activities, such as code review, estimation, technical specification planning, collaboration in requirements definition, and contribution of feedback during retrospectives.

s.h: Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through
s.t:
Author a technical specification plan for a roadmap project and collaborate with teammates to create an agreed upon delivery plan.
Mentor junior teammates to provide guidance and coaching on code implementation, design review, and other software engineering and Agile practices.
Understand how the team uses React and Typescript frameworks and be comfortable explaining relevant details to other engineers.
Collaborate effectively with product managers to ensure that projects are delivered on time and with quality.
Understand the how we structure, build and deploy the apps and be comfortable explaining relevant details to other engineers.
Have knowledge of your team’s target customer base and their most common use cases within the application.

s.h: Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by
s.t:
Have an understanding of all aspects of our web application, including every module, less common use cases and all the Personas within our user base.
Demonstrate end-to-end responsibility for delivering roadmap projects on time, from technical planning to performing/guiding implementation to testing to final delivery.
Balance the continuum of trade-offs during code design, knowing that solutions can favor faster delivery with less strict technical requirements or solutions can favor future technical maintainability with delayed delivery of customer value.
Identify a technical initiative (e.g. technical debt, introduction of a new system, need for a new JavaScript dependency, performance improvement, etc) for your team.
Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

About Fundraise Up
We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.
Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.
A Truly Global Product
We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.
We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals , admin tools , and several internal apps.
Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB . The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React , with nearly all code written in TypeScript . We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Transport Software team at IonQ, based in our Oxford office. In this role you will work with physicists to develop ion trap control software, guiding the trajectories of hundreds to thousands of ions in parallel using electromagnetic fields. This will directly contribute to the team's mission of scaling the computational capacity of our trapped-ion quantum computers.
This role will play a central role in shaping the control software that supports our work in building the world's most advanced quantum systems.

In this position, you will develop our framework for describing ion transport constraints and, in combination with an electromagnetic model of the ion trap, synthesise voltage waveform data to drive hundreds to thousands of independent DAC channels, with runtime parametrisation to enable closed-loop calibration and mid-circuit feedforward.

Supporting the transport waveform team in developing new solvers and physics simulations as components in this framework.
Collaborating with experimental and theoretical scientists to understand their requirements for experiment and simulation.
Contributing to the design of transport operations used for quantum circuits, and how they are parametrised and calibrated.

s.t: HPC Systems Software Engineer – OpenCHAMI for Lugano or Zürich (professione segnalata)

Questo progetto, con sede di lavoro a Lugano o a Zurigo, si concentra sullo sviluppo e il potenziamento di OpenCHAMI per l’infrastruttura di supercalcolo di nuova generazione del CSCS. Il lavoro contribuirà alla creazione di un approccio aperto, scalabile e moderno alla gestione dei cluster per sistemi di calcolo ad alte prestazioni (HPC) su larga scala.
L’obiettivo principale è progettare, sviluppare, integrare e implementare funzionalità di OpenCHAMI su misura per i requisiti operativi dei supercomputer del CSCS.
Il progetto affronterà le sfide legate alla gestione di sistemi HPC e di intelligenza artificiale (AI) sempre più complessi e contribuirà all’evoluzione delle tecnologie open source di gestione dei cluster di nuova generazione.

Offriamo un contratto iniziale di due anni che ti darà l’opportunità di lavorare all’avanguardia nell’ambito delle infrastrutture HPC e di intelligenza artificiale presso il CSCS, contribuendo direttamente allo sviluppo di tecnologie che supporteranno i futuri sistemi di supercalcolo.
Avrai l’opportunità di contribuire a OpenCHAMI e alle relative iniziative open source, collaborando con la più ampia comunità HPC e partecipando a programmi di grande impatto sia a livello nazionale che internazionale, tra cui HPSF, OpenCHAMI e iniziative correlate.

Sviluppare e ampliare OpenCHAMI per soddisfare i requisiti operativi e di gestione dell’infrastruttura dei sistemi di supercalcolo attuali e di prossima generazione del CSCS.
Contribuire all’ecosistema open source di OpenCHAMI, compresi lo sviluppo, l’integrazione e l’evoluzione dei servizi e dei componenti correlati alla gestione dei cluster.
Sviluppare flussi di lavoro di automazione e gestione per migliorare il provisioning, la configurazione, il monitoraggio, la manutenzione e l’efficienza operativa dei sistemi su larga scala.
Collaborare strettamente con i team operativi HPC per comprendere i requisiti e le sfide operative e tradurli in soluzioni basate su OpenCHAMI robuste, scalabili e di facile manutenzione.
Contribuire all’architettura e all’evoluzione della piattaforma OpenCHAMI, garantendo che le soluzioni siano scalabili, affidabili, gestibili e allineate alle esigenze dei sistemi HPC e di IA su larga scala.
Partecipare attivamente ai flussi di lavoro di sviluppo open source, tra cui la progettazione del software, l’implementazione, i test, le revisioni del codice, il tracciamento dei problemi e le discussioni tecniche all’interno della comunità OpenCHAMI.
Collaborare con partner internazionali e con la più ampia comunità HPC per sviluppare e integrare soluzioni che promuovano la gestione dei cluster open source e l’automazione delle infrastrutture.
Redigere e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica, inclusi progetti di architettura, guide all’implementazione, procedure operative e best practice.
Valutare tecnologie e approcci emergenti rilevanti per la gestione delle infrastrutture HPC, l’osservabilità e l’automazione, e contribuire alla loro adozione ove opportuno.

Accogliamo con favore ingegneri con background diversi che siano desiderosi di contribuire alla nostra missione. Cerchiamo principalmente solide basi tecniche, un buon giudizio ingegneristico e la capacità di colmare le lacune tra i diversi ambiti. Curiosità, adattabilità, disponibilità ad apprendere sul campo e potenziale di crescita contano per noi più di una perfetta corrispondenza iniziale con i requisiti tecnici.

s.t:
Linguaggio di programmazione Go
Git e flussi di lavoro moderni per lo sviluppo software
Pipeline CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub, Ansible)

Sviluppo di software open source
Framework di test, pratiche di qualità del software e approcci DevOps/GitOps

Einleitungstext
The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates a high-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.
Projekthintergrund

This project with work location either Lugano or Zürich focuses on the development and advancement of OpenCHAMI for CSCS’s next-generation supercomputing infrastructure. The work will contribute to building an open, scalable, and modern approach to cluster management for large-scale High Performance Computing (HPC) systems.
The main objective is to design, develop, integrate, and deploy OpenCHAMI capabilities tailored to the operational requirements of CSCS supercomputers.
The project will address the challenges of managing increasingly complex HPC and AI systems and contribute to the evolution of next-generation open-source cluster management technologies.

We value technical excellence, curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn and grow over a perfect checklist of skills. Working on next-generation HPC infrastructure requires a willingness to explore new technologies, tackle complex problems, and continuously develop new expertise.
If you are motivated to make a meaningful impact in this area but do not meet every requirement, we strongly encourage you to apply.

We offer an initially two-year contract providing the opportunity to work at the forefront of HPC and AI infrastructure at CSCS, contributing directly to the development of technologies that will support future supercomputing systems.
You will have the opportunity to contribute to OpenCHAMI and related open-source initiatives, collaborating with the broader HPC community and contributing to high-impact programs at both the national and international levels, including HPSF, OpenCHAMI, and related initiatives.
This is an opportunity to help shape how future CSCS supercomputers are managed, monitored, and operated, while contributing to open-source technologies with an impact well beyond a single system or institution.
Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
Develop and extend OpenCHAMI to meet the infrastructure management and operational requirements of CSCS’s current and next-generation supercomputing systems.
Contribute to the OpenCHAMI open-source ecosystem, including the development, integration, and evolution of related cluster management services and components.
Develop automation and management workflows to improve system provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and operational efficiency at scale.
Collaborate closely with HPC operations teams to understand operational requirements and challenges, and translate them into robust, scalable, and maintainable OpenCHAMI-based solutions.
Contribute to the architecture and evolution of the OpenCHAMI platform, ensuring that solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with the needs of large-scale HPC and AI systems.
Participate actively in open-source development workflows, including software design, implementation, testing, code reviews, issue tracking, and technical discussions within the OpenCHAMI community.

Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
🎯 Your main goal will be to keep n8n operating as an AI-native engineering organization where agents are embedded across the development cycle; helping teams plan, build, test, review, learn, and improve.
You’ll do this by maintaining and evolving the platform foundations, tools, guardrails, and team processes that make agentic development safe, measurable, and sustainable. Working with Developer Platform, Security, AI/Agents, Architecture, and product engineering teams, you’ll help teams continuously adopt what works from frontier AI and make success visible through faster feedback loops, better quality, stronger resilience, and more learning from what we ship:

s.h: BUILD THE PAVED ROAD FOR AGENTIC DEVELOPMENT
s.t:
Define safe task categories for autonomous agents, including what they can attempt, what they should never touch, and where additional review is required.
Design and implement isolated execution environments where agents can work without exposing secrets or accessing sensitive systems unnecessarily.
Build pilot workflows that allow selected Linear issues to be picked up by agents, tested, and converted into useful draft PRs.

Create and maintain repo instructions, agent playbooks, ownership metadata, coding guidelines, and documentation that improve agent performance.
Continuously improve developer workflows, repo structure, testability, and documentation based on where agents succeed, fail, or create reviewer friction.
Partner with Architecture and senior engineers to define boundaries, dependencies, and areas where agents need more context or tighter constraints.

Integrate agentic workflows with Linear, GitHub, CI, test infrastructure, and developer review processes.
Design PR evidence templates that help reviewers understand what changed, why, what tests ran, what risks remain, and where human judgment is needed.
Partner with Security, AI/Agents, Developer Platform, and product engineering teams to define guardrails for sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions, and data handling.

Create benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate agent output quality, failure modes, test pass rates, review burden, and production risk.
Define quality signals and adoption metrics such as draft PR usefulness rate, reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate, and developer satisfaction.
Use data and feedback from pilot teams to improve agent workflows, reduce unsafe attempts, and build trust across engineering.

Must-haves
🧠 Autonomous coding agents: You have experience with autonomous coding agents, AI coding platforms, agent orchestration systems, or internal AI developer tooling.
🤖 Agentic development experience: You have practical experience building, deploying, or operating AI-assisted or agentic software development workflows that work with developers not besides them.
🛠️ Strong engineering foundations: You have a strong software engineering background, ideally in platform engineering, developer experience, infrastructure, tooling, CI/CD, or engineering productivity.
🧭 Ambiguity leadership: You’re comfortable leading a first-of-a-kind technical initiative from problem definition through pilot, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
🔁 Modern engineering workflows: You deeply understand GitHub, CI, testing strategies, code review, monorepos, issue tracking, developer environments, and release risk.
🔐 Safety-first judgment: You have strong judgment around permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths, and human-in-the-loop review.
📊 Measurable systems thinking: You know how to design benchmarks, quality signals, failure-mode tracking, and adoption metrics.
✍️ Clear written communication: You’re strong at writing repo instructions, playbooks, PR evidence templates, technical proposals, and alignment documents.
🤝 Cross-functional influence: You have credibility with senior engineers and can influence across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security, and Architecture without formal authority.
Nice-to-haves
📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js, or JavaScript monorepo.
⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, automated testing infrastructure, preview environments, or internal developer platforms.
🛡️ Security-aware platform engineering: You have worked on sandboxing, secrets management, least-privilege access, or sensitive code ownership.
📏 AI evaluation: You have created evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or quality metrics for AI-generated code or automation systems.
🌍 Open-source communities: You have experience contributing to open-source or source-available projects with active developer communities.
🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling, and customer trust are central.
🔗 Workflow automation: You’re familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration, or developer-facing products.

At n8n, you’ll help define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies.
